table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname=I.name,
	itemalias=I.customicode,
	date=A.date,
	Batch=A.Batch,
	qty=ISNULL(A.qty,0),
	value=ISNULL(A.qty*Case :ai_pricetype 
								WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.purprice / I.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.Saleprice / I.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.avgprice, 2)
                     END,0),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=I.manfcode),
	manfcode=I.manfcode
FROM 
	item I,
	(select 
		icode=SD.icode,
		batch = SD.Batch,
		date=convert(datetime,convert(varchar(15),SL.date,101)),
		qty=ISNULL(sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty),0)
	 from saleledger SL, saledetail SD, Item I
	 where SL.date>=:ad_startdate and
	       SL.date<=:ad_enddate and
	       SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
	       SD.icode=I.icode and
	       I.manfcode IN (:aa_manfcode)
	 group by 
			convert(datetime,convert(varchar(15),SL.date,101)),
		  	SD.icode,
			SD.Batch
	UNION ALL
	select 
		icode=SD.icode,
		batch = SD.Batch,
		date=convert(datetime,convert(varchar(15),SL.date,101)),
		qty=ISNULL(sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty),0)
	 from saleledger SL, saleinvdetail SD, Item I
	 where SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
			 SL.date>=:ad_startdate and
	       SL.date<=:ad_enddate and
	       SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
	       SD.icode=I.icode and
	       I.manfcode IN (:aa_manfcode)
	 group by 
			convert(datetime,convert(varchar(15),SL.date,101)),
		  	SD.icode,
			SD.Batch) AS A
WHERE 
	I.manfcode IN (:aa_manfcode) AND
	I.icode=A.icode
ORDER by 
	manufacturer,
	A.date,
	itemname,
	Batch
